channel.title: Liberia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Liberia, every source cited.

item.title: Swiss court upholds Kosiah's 20-year war crimes sentence
item.description: Former ULIMO commander Alieu Kosiah will serve 20 years for atrocities in Lofa County during Liberia's civil war.

item.title: Liberia receives 30 road machines for farmers
item.description: Heavy equipment aims to improve access to markets for agricultural produce in Bong County.

item.title: Liberia resumes classes after teacher pay deal
item.description: Monrovia Consolidated School System enrolls 409 volunteer teachers on payroll and begins salary disbursements.

item.title: Whein Town residents demand landfill closure
item.description: Residents of Whein Town, Liberia, are calling for the permanent closure of the local landfill due to health concerns and unfulfilled government promises.

item.title: Liberia court stalls corruption case over $1.7 million fund
item.description: Rural women traders in River Cess County express anger as officials allegedly stole money meant for their empowerment.
